meaning:
χρονίζω
(χρόνος), [in LXX chiefly for אָחַר pi. ;]
to spend or take time, to tarry, linger, delay: Mat.24:48 25:5, Heb.10:37; before ἐν, with dative loc., Luk.1:21; with inf., Luk.12:45.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: will be away a long time

elsewhere.note: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
“In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
